The '''Zarazan Farmstead''' was a moisture farm operated by the [[Exchange]], located east of [[Mos Ila]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Casey Rix]] lived on the farmstead. [[Izzeebowe Jeef]] lived in a hut a short walk from the rest of the farmstead.
